main_decision_implemented.only_runner: this launcher is the ONLY clean4 final-evaluation runner (N4 switches the in-run u8/u24 evaluations off); any foreign v2v_final charge in the clean4 ledger blocks it
main_decision_implemented.budget: debited from clean4 v2v_final (690,000 sim-s) in the clean4 run-root ledger, through the clean4 owner's whole-wave reservation (track2_backend._reserve, as the clean3 lane-on baseline); hard sub-cap 690,000 on this launcher's job ids

panel.panel_sha256_kind: sealed content digest (tools.coopmwm.protocol.digest, CRLF/LF independent); pinned as nm_finaleval.PANEL_SHA256
panel.registered: 2026-11-06, committed in 03f8db32 before any clean4 launch (c4/nm-train head 70eee181 has no launch commit)
panel.worlds: 96: world_id wz3to2_<seed>, world {map wz3to2, seed 989600..989695, cell 0, repeat 0..95, penetration 0.3, demand 2800, profile peak}
panel.cell: single clean4 training cell = DEMAND_CHOSEN.json (main 2800 veh/h peak profile, penetration 0.3, departLane free)
panel.built_from: MAP_SPEC.json / DEMAND_CHOSEN.json / wz3to2.net.xml bytes only (digests bound in map_binding); test_panel_rebuilds_from_the_map_files_only reproduces it exactly
panel.contract: arms A/B/R u24 + BASE + NATIVE; comparisons B-A, R-A, B-R; total benefit vs BASE and NATIVE; J_veh_s (team delay, lower better) over [0,1200); noise seed = world seed; registered clean3 estimator (planner_eval._paired_ci, 10000 reps, seed 20261104, 95%, paired whole-world percentile); safety collisions/teleports/hard_brakes/ttc_events
panel.primary_registered_descriptive: B-BASE: CI95 of mean(J_B - J_BASE) entirely below 0 AND B collisions+teleports <= BASE; never gates clean4; the clean4 primary criterion (u24 replicated synergy on TRAIN states, N4) is unchanged
panel.decisions: B and R; first 2-3-member cooperation decision with 300 <= t <= 840 s (time order only, outcome-blind) on the 24 subset worlds; 360 s branches from the saved state: all / background (BASE controller) / each member alone; clean3 ISOLATED_TEST decomposition (delta_all = best_solo + policy_cooperation_gain)
panel.power: N=96 paired worlds: MDE 0.286 SD of the per-world difference (alpha .05, power .80); probe noise basis SD 3,022 veh-s per 360 s (n=126) -> ~1,580 veh-s per 1200 s world-episode if windows independent; decision subset <=24/arm -> MDE ~1,720 veh-s (descriptive)
panel.exposure: eval range absent from the newmap_probe ledger (989000-989006 only). DISCLOSED: integers 989600-989635 are the OLD merge-map S-COOPMWM final_test seeds (tools/coopmwm/protocol.py FINAL_START); wz3to2 streams are map-namespaced (newmap_requests_v1:{map}:{seed}, sample_driver('{map}:{seed}', id)), ids carry the wz3to2_ prefix

base_mappo_u0.decisions_ceiling: 2 arms x 24 worlds x 5 branches x 360 = 86,400

budget_quote.reservation: planned sim-s precharged per job; every wave reserved whole before dispatch; only captured decisions reserved (closing_pair 4 branches, abreast_wall 5)
budget_quote.wall_time: about 0.85-1.3 h on 24 workers (basis 6-9 sim-s/s per worker from the newmap_probe cpuV runs; policy inference may be slower)
